bullets.text: BT's Sovereign Platform Launched - **BT** introduces a new platform to enhance digital sovereignty for UK businesses and public sector.
AI-Driven Network Optimization - AI technologies are set to revolutionize network planning, enabling proactive maintenance and reduced downtime.
Lumine Acquires Synchronoss - **Lumine Group** expands its portfolio by acquiring **Synchronoss** for $116.4 million, enhancing cloud services.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense Centers - **NTT DATA** announces new centers in the UK to bolster cybersecurity with AI technologies.
Cloudflare Outage Highlights Risks - Recent outages emphasize the fragility of concentrated cloud infrastructure in telecom networks.
AI Monetization for Telcos - Telecom companies are exploring AI services, with projected revenues reaching $4 billion by 2025.
Vodacom Gains Majority in Safaricom - **Vodacom** acquires a $2.1 billion stake in **Safaricom**, increasing its control to 55%.
Private 5G for AI Integration - **Celona** positions private 5G as a key infrastructure layer for AI in industrial settings.
